def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, a1, a2, a3, b1, b2, b3 = map(int, data)
    max_val = min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1)
    min_val = min(a1, b1 + b3) + min(a2, b1 + b2) + min(a3, b2 + b3)
    min_val = n - min_val
    print(f"{min_val} {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
